title: React Module 08 Applied Check
description: Apply custom Hook design to extraction choices, dependency handling, return APIs, composition, testing awareness, and common reusable hooks.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Two components duplicate window resize subscription logic. What is a good custom Hook direction?

options.text: Extract the subscription and cleanup into something like `useWindowSize`
Copy the code into every new component
Move the logic into global mutable variables only
Put the resize listener directly in JSX

questions.explanation: A custom Hook can reuse subscription logic while each component keeps its own render UI.

questions.prompt: A well-designed `useDebouncedValue(value, delay)` should usually do which things? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Track debounced state
Set and clear a timer in an effect
Include `value` and `delay` as dependencies
Render the input element itself

questions.explanation: The hook manages timing behavior and returns a value; the component remains responsible for UI.

questions.prompt: Why is `function getOnlineStatus() { const [online] = useState(true); }` a poor custom Hook name?

options.text: It calls a Hook but does not start with `use`
It returns too many DOM nodes
It uses a boolean
It is not in a class

questions.explanation: Functions that call Hooks should be React components or custom Hooks named with `use`.

questions.prompt: Custom Hooks are a good place to hide all UI markup so consuming components cannot control rendering.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanation: Custom Hooks usually extract behavior and state, while components decide how to render UI.

questions.prompt: Which are good testing-aware custom Hook practices? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Keep inputs and outputs explicit
Separate pure helper logic when possible
Mock or control external systems such as storage or fetch in tests
Rely only on manual clicking forever

questions.explanation: Clear APIs and separated logic make hooks easier to test; external systems need controlled test doubles.

questions.prompt: A hook named `useLocalStorageState` reads from localStorage during every render. What improvement is usually better?

options.text: Use lazy initial state to read the initial value once
Call localStorage in JSX attributes
Store the value only in a ref and never render updates
Make the hook conditional

questions.explanation: Lazy initialization avoids repeated storage reads during every render.

questions.prompt: Which return API choices can be reasonable for custom Hooks? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Return an object for named values when there are several fields
Return a tuple for small state/setter-style APIs
Return undocumented values in a changing order
Return functions that let the component trigger behavior

questions.explanation: Objects, tuples, and functions can all be good APIs when they are predictable and clear.

questions.prompt: A custom `useFetch` hook starts a request in an effect but never handles stale responses when the URL changes quickly. What risk appears?

options.text: An older response may overwrite newer data
React will stop supporting effects
The URL becomes a key automatically
The component cannot ever unmount

questions.explanation: Async hooks should guard cancellation or stale responses so old requests do not win after inputs change.
